production.prompt: Identity-preserving production game sprites derived from the attached canonical character. The EXACT youthful adult male elf Mike: blue eyes, long blond hair tied behind, pointed ears, blue robe with detailed gold trim, BLACK gloves, black boots, red-brown gold spellbook, sheathed dagger. Do not feminize, change face or use chibi proportions. His book is deliberately secured in its belt pouch whenever BOTH hands work; otherwise keep it in his anatomical LEFT arm. Gloves stay black in every pose. Eight distinct chronological phases of one natural rightward walking cycle while holding a rolled parchment firmly in the LEFT hand. Right hand swings gently. Smooth leg alternation, no running or sliding. The same person and scroll throughout. No other props. Fixed southeast three-quarter view of hero facing RIGHT, exactly the canonical face, proportions, costume, palette and pixel-painted rendering of the reference, no redesign. A regular EXACT FOUR columns by TWO rows grid, eight complete isolated frames in reading order. ALL figures fully visible inside their cells with generous transparent safety margins. Constant body scale in all frames, shortened crouched silhouette is NOT a smaller person. Landscape 2:1 sheet, each cell contains only the hero. Real transparent background; no ground, shadows, labels, numbers, borders or text. High detail at native size, ideally 350+ pixels for standing human figure per cell. Do not use old loading-character designs.
